Oppenheimer & Company Decreased Teva Pharmaceutical Inds LTD (TEVA) Stake; Willis Lease Finance (WLFC)’s Sentiment Is 1.29
May 15, 2018 - By Nellie Frank
Oppenheimer & Company Inc decreased Teva Pharmaceutical Inds Ltd (TEVA) stake by 18.08% reported in 2017Q4 SEC filing. Oppenheimer & Company Inc sold 27,242 shares as Teva Pharmaceutical Inds Ltd (TEVA)’s stock declined 11.04%. The Oppenheimer & Company Inc holds 123,427 shares with $2.34 million value, down from 150,669 last quarter. Teva Pharmaceutical Inds Ltd now has $20.68 billion valuation. The stock decreased 0.34% or $0.07 during the last trading session, reaching $20.31. About 5.79M shares traded. Teva Pharmaceutical Industries Limited (NYSE:TEVA) has declined 49.50% since May 15, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 61.05% the S&P500.
Willis Lease Finance Corp (WLFC) investors sentiment decreased to 1.29 in 2017 Q4 . It’s down -0.11, from 1.4 in 2017Q3. The ratio is negative, as 22 investment professionals opened new or increased positions, while 17 sold and decreased their stock positions in Willis Lease Finance Corp. The investment professionals in our database now own: 2.23 million shares, down from 2.26 million shares in 2017Q3. Also, the number of investment professionals holding Willis Lease Finance Corp in top ten positions was flat from 0 to 0 for the same number . Sold All: 1 Reduced: 16 Increased: 15 New Position: 7.
Willis Lease Finance Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, leases commercial aircraft engines and other aircraft-related equipment to air carriers, manufacturers, and overhaul/repair facilities worldwide. The company has market cap of $209.33 million. It operates through two divisions, Equipment Leasing and Spare Parts Sales. It has a 3.4 P/E ratio. The firm also purchases and resells new and used commercial aircraft engines, as well as sells aircraft engine parts and materials.
Since January 1, 0001, it had 1 buy, and 6 sales for $449,172 activity.
Rutabaga Capital Management Llc Ma holds 0.29% of its portfolio in Willis Lease Finance Corporation for 50,874 shares. Menta Capital Llc owns 21,350 shares or 0.1% of their US portfolio. Moreover, Rbf Capital Llc has 0.08% invested in the company for 30,000 shares. The New York-based Maltese Capital Management Llc has invested 0.05% in the stock. Bridgeway Capital Management Inc, a Texas-based fund reported 146,550 shares.
The stock increased 1.14% or $0.37 during the last trading session, reaching $32.92. About 25,116 shares traded or 54.27% up from the average. Willis Lease Finance Corporation (WLFC) has risen 47.40% since May 15, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 35.85% the S&P500.
Analysts await Teva Pharmaceutical Industries Limited (NYSE:TEVA) to report earnings on August, 2. They expect $0.59 earnings per share, down 40.40% or $0.40 from last year’s $0.99 per share. TEVA’s profit will be $600.75 million for 8.61 P/E if the $0.59 EPS becomes a reality. After $0.91 actual earnings per share reported by Teva Pharmaceutical Industries Limited for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts -35.16% negative EPS growth.
Oppenheimer & Company Inc increased First Tr Exchange Traded Fd (QQXT) stake by 8,560 shares to 36,114 valued at $1.76M in 2017Q4. It also upped Activision Blizzard Inc (NASDAQ:ATVI) stake by 14,552 shares and now owns 80,901 shares. Global X Fds was raised too.
